DEPARTMENT RESPONSIBILITIES
CORE FINANCIAL OPERATIONS
 Processed nearly 20,000 vendor invoices in 2025
 Vendor payments issued weekly (every other week prior to 2023)
 Processed city payroll twice monthly (once monthly prior to 2025) for
 approximately:
    640 permanent full-time and
    320 part-time employees
    Seasonal staff
 Oversee accounts receivable, including collections of debt owed to the City
 Reconciles over 1,000 asset and liability general ledger accounts monthly
 Accounts for all City fixed assets (nearly 3,200 pieces of equipment, buildings,
 vehicles, land, etc.)
 Deposits approximately $520,000 daily
